Class OutlierDetectionConfiguration

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.client.loadbalance.OutlierDetectionConfiguration
Direct Known Subclasses:
ServiceHttpClientConfiguration.ServiceOutlierDetectionConfiguration
public class OutlierDetectionConfiguration extends Object
Outlier detection of a load balanced service: an instance whose exchanges keep failing is ejected, i.e. not selected, for a while, and tried again afterwards. The clients report the outcome of every exchange to the LoadBalancer, which counts the consecutive failures of each instance.
  • Transport failures always count: the connection could not be opened, the response did not arrive in time, or the connection or the stream was reset before the response was complete. getConsecutiveFailures() of them in a row eject the instance.
  • Responses with a status of 500 or above count only when getConsecutiveServerErrors() is positive, since a server error may be the fault of one request rather than of the instance.
  • A success resets both counts.
  • An instance is ejected for getBaseEjectionTime(), multiplied by the number of times it was ejected, up to getMaxEjectionTime(); the multiplier is reset by a success after it was tried again.
  • No more than getMaxEjectionPercent() of the instances of the service are ejected at once, and when every instance that is up is ejected, the instances are selected as if none were.
Configured per service under micronaut.http.services.<id>.outlier-detection, and disabled by default.
Since:
5.3.0

Denis Stepanov
